final_content.statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a surjective flat morphism of schemes. If $X$ is reduced (each local ring of $X$ has no nonzero nilpotent element), then $Y$ is reduced. No finiteness assumption on $f$ is required.
hypotheses: f:X→Y is flat and surjective and X reduced.

semantic_review_note: Pinned descent.tex L5076 asserts reducedness descends along any flat, surjective morphism of schemes; no finite-presentation hypothesis is present. The reconstruction retains flatness, surjectivity, reduced source and reduced target, without replacing f by an fppf cover or asserting the false converse.
